text:
sara (procurement): Heads-up — FRA warehouse published a 4h dock-slot auction for next Tue 09:00 CET. We have 12 RMA H100s inbound that need staging + serial QC. Do we want to bid to consolidate or split across two slots?

mike (infra): Need to know cost delta. If we consolidate into one slot we save AWB and handling but risk queue/thermal delays. What's the reserve nudge? :thinking_face:

alina (logistics): Consolidation + single AWB is my vote. We can reduce carrier fees ~€850 and insurance stays the same. But we need vendor to agree to hold inventory 48–72h pre-slot.

vendor_anna (Nexasupply): Can hold up to 48h without extra fees. >72h triggers storage surcharge (~€45/unit/day). Also: some serials need depot mark checks — adds ~30m/unit of staging time.

tom (ops): If staging is 30m/unit, 12 units = 6 hours, so a 4h slot won't cut it unless we parallelize teams. Do we have staff for parallel QC that morning?

mike (infra): We can run two QC lanes if we get an extra tech. Ops team headcount is tight. Parallelize only if vendor can pre-do basic power-on tests. vendor_anna?

vendor_anna (Nexasupply): We can do a basic POST and serial reconciliation on our side (no full burn) for up to 10 units. For the remaining 2 we'd still need you on-site.

sara (procurement): OK — proposed plan: bid for one 6h slot (auction allows custom duration) with a reserve price of €3,250 for FRA dock. Consolidate into one AWB, vendor does POST on 10 units, we send 2 techs for on-site QC. That keeps storage under 48h. Thoughts?

mike (infra): That seems safe. Can we cap the maximum bid at €4,200? If auction goes above that, fallback to split into two 4h slots (higher handling fees).

alina (logistics): Split plan note: two slots will require two AWBs and add ~€1,100 in carrier/manifest fees. Also increases customs checks risk.

tom (ops): Approve subject to vendor_anna confirming POST for 10 units and what time they can release to us. Also need printed RMA labels + depot codes — provide template: 
```
RMA-REF: RI-2026-0456
AWB: TBD
HS_CODE: 8471.50.00
```

vendor_anna (Nexasupply): Can do POSTs tomorrow afternoon and hand off to carrier Monday evening. We'll provide serial reconciliation CSV by 20:00 CET Mon.

sara (procurement): Great. I'll place a provisional max-bid of €4,200 and request a 6h slot. If auction clears under €3,250 we take it; if between €3,250-€4,200 we need quick OK from @mike and @tom.

ops-bot: :calendar: Auction reminder created — Tue 09:00 CET, FRA dock-slot auction. Link: https://dock-auctions.example/1755551231

mike (infra): Quick check on insurance: current transit policy covers declared value up to €1.2M with sublimit for refurbished units. For consolidated AWB we should declare full value or risk claim split headaches. What's declared value per unit?

alina (logistics): Declared value per H100 unit = €55,000. For 12 units that's €660,000. I'll mark declared value as full to avoid partial claim fragmentation.

vendor_anna (Nexasupply): Noted. If consolidated AWB, claims will go through our broker — we need the invoice copy at hand on handover.

tom (ops): Last ops note — customs: FRA has flagged new HS code verification for 8471 shipments. Add 1 extra hour buffer for customs clearance on the day. So even 6h slot is tight. Recommend softly prefer 8h if auction allows.

sara (procurement): Okay update: change to target 8h slot, reserve €3,250, cap €4,500. If auction doesn't offer 8h, fall back to two 4h slots and we accept split AWBs. @vendor_anna confirm you can still do 10 POSTs and provide CSV by Mon 20:00 CET?

vendor_anna (Nexasupply): Confirmed. We'll also include photo evidence of packaging and a quick thermal-read log for each unit in the CSV.

mike (infra): All right. I can approve bids up to €4,500 during auction window. Team be ready to hit approve. :thumbsup:

sara (procurement): Thanks — I'll start the provisional auction order now and ping during the live window. If we win, I'll post AWB and the RMA label payload here for final sign-off.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Auction bid submitted (provisional). ID: AUCTION-1755551231-PEND

alina (logistics): One more thing — if we consolidate, please provide a single receiver contact and onsite phone for customs. Use: "Redwood Ops Dock — +49 30 555 0102"

sara (procurement): Added contact. Will update thread with final AWB and expected ETA once we have auction result. :rocket:
